title: Characterizing resonant solitary states as relative equilibria via normal form reduction
summary: We investigate solitary states in coupled oscillator networks, where a single oscillator detaches from a synchronized cluster and evolves at a distinct mean frequency. We focus on resonant solitary states, in which the mean frequency of the detached oscillator is shaped by resonance with a mode of the cluster. Here, we introduce a normal-form and symmetry-based approach to identify such states.
